# NeoLibrary

> NeoLibrary, by Rob Tyrie of Ironstone Advisory, is an open engine that turns a collection of documents into connected knowledge objects that keep their sources. It grew out of MetaRAG (June 2024): grounding language models in a curated, consensus library of documents instead of a database. Code is Apache 2.0; documents are CC BY 4.0.

## Canonical definitions

- [RFC-0001: definitions and scope](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0001-definitions.md): NeoLibrary, MetaRAG, book (document), knowledge object, provenance spine, Neolibrarian, DAC-EK, the Helix
- [RFC-0002: knowledge objects and the provenance spine](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0002-knowledge-objects-and-provenance.md): the rules every knowledge object follows
- [RFC-0003: plugin contract and open-core boundary](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0003-plugin-contract.md)
